verdict.rationale: Crossplane is a headless, declarative Kubernetes control plane that is installed via a scriptable Helm command and exposes APIs that 'humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on.' Its official CLI can render and test Composition Functions without a cluster and can build and push packages, both of which fit CI pipelines. Community comments describe it fitting into GitOps workflows with Flux/ArgoCD and continuously enforcing state, although the GitOps remark is phrased as a question rather than a hands-on report. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs or examples (e.g., pipeline recipes or non-interactive auth guidance), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
